subject: Exec liaison allocation + EB availability to finalize MAP & close timeline

Subject: MAP + EB request — proposed gating dates

Hi Camila,

Thanks for the demo last week. The executive team at Aurelia wants a short mutual action plan and an executive briefing (EB) to validate security posture and integration timelines. Procurement is asking for a concrete 6-week close plan so they can align budget approvals.

High-level asks from our side:

- MAP with deliverables and acceptance criteria by next Friday (we can be flexible on owners)
- A simple decision gating timeline so procurement can finish PO approval by Oct 15

We are sending a skeleton MAP attached (Aurelia_MAP_v1.xlsx). Can you propose an exec sponsor mapping (who from Redwood will own each gate) and a few EB date options?

Sandra

Team — moving Aurelia to close window; they want a compact MAP + an EB to unblock procurement. I attached the MAP_v2 draft and an EB availability matrix (also attach in calendar-friendly CSV). Please review and reply with:

1) Confirmation you can be the proposed sponsor owner (Ben: commercial; Marissa: technical; Karthik: CS).
2) Top 3 acceptance criteria you want documented in the MAP for your gate. Keep them specific and measurable.
3) Any pre-reads you need for the EB (we want to keep it to 45 minutes).

I propose we aim for Option A (Oct 6 morning) — procurement wants a decision runway that finishes by Oct 15. If we pick Oct 6, I’ll send an invite with the short agenda and the mutual actions grid.

Attachment references: EB_availability_matrix.csv, MAP_v2_2026-09-29.pdf.

Thanks — Camila
